title: Shower liner test.
officialText:
Where shower floors and receptors are made watertight by the application of materials required by Section
417.5.2, the completed liner installation shall be tested. The pipe from the shower drain shall be plugged water-tight for the test. The
floor and receptor area shall be filled with potable water to a depth of not less than 2 inches (51 mm) measured at the threshold.
Where a threshold of at least 2 inches (51 mm) high does not exist, a temporary threshold shall be constructed to retain the test water
in the lined floor or receptor area to a level not less than 2 inches (51 mm) deep measured at the threshold. The water shall be
retained for a test period of not less than 15 minutes, and there shall not be evidence of leakage.
